layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (largest, bold, red). The right 3D batch block is the largest graphic; the middle 4x5 grid is medium; the left 5-cube stack is smallest. Label boxes are small bold multi-colored text; rotated dimension-arrow labels are the smallest text.

visual_elements.description: Thin red rectangular border framing the entire slide, inset ~2% from edges; below the title a thin blue rectangular border encloses all three diagram columns.
Slide-number badge: yellow filled circle with red outline containing the number 42 in red bold sans-serif.

Left label box: white fill, thin red border, two centered lines of bold sans-serif text. Line 1: 'Feature Vector of One Input' with 'One' in green and the rest in red. Line 2: 'Sample (Using one filter)' with 'one filter' in blue and the rest in red.

Middle label box: white fill, thin red border, two centered lines of bold text. Line 1: 'Feature Vectors of One Input Sample' with 'One' green, rest red. Line 2: '(Using 4 filters)  [4 Channels]' with '4 filters' and '[4 Channels]' in blue, parentheses in red.

Right label box: white fill, thin red border, three left-aligned/centered lines of bold text. Line 1: 'Feature Vectors of :' in red. Line 2: 'FIVE  Input Samples  [mini-Batch]' with 'FIVE' in green bold, 'Input Samples' red, '[mini-Batch]' bold red/magenta. Line 3: 'Using 4 filters [4 Channels]' with '4 filters' and '[4 Channels]' in blue bold, 'Using' red.

Left 3D cube stack: 5 identical cubes stacked vertically in a single column (1 wide x 5 tall), each drawn obliquely with a bright-green front face, a mid-green top parallelogram and a dark-green right-side parallelogram, thin white gaps between cubes; represents one feature vector of length 5 computed with one filter.
visual_elements.position: left column below its label, ~16-23% width, ~46-80% height

visual_elements.description: Middle 3D cube grid: 4 columns x 5 rows = 20 identical green cubes viewed slightly from above (top faces visible as parallelograms, right-side faces visible on the rightmost cubes), thin white gaps; represents the 4 feature vectors (one per channel/filter) of a single input sample, each of length 5.
visual_elements.position: center column below its label, ~39-54% width, ~44-78% height

visual_elements.description: Right 3D batch block: five 4-wide x 5-tall cube layers stacked in depth, each successive layer offset up and to the right (oblique projection). Front-to-back layer colors: magenta, yellow, orange, green, blue. Top faces of the four rear layers and the right-side faces of the rearmost blue layer are visible. A small white/gray arrow between the magenta and yellow layers near the top points down-right, indicating the stacking (batch) direction. Semantics: each layer = feature vectors of one input sample (4 channels x length 5); 5 layers = mini-batch of 5 samples.
visual_elements.position: right column below its label, ~63-90% width, ~42-93% height

visual_elements.description: Vertical red double-headed arrow to the left of the magenta layer spanning its full height; label 'Feature Vector' in red bold rotated 90 degrees (reading bottom-to-top) alongside it.

visual_elements.description: Horizontal red double-headed arrow beneath the magenta layer spanning its width; labels 'Channels' and '(4 Filters)' stacked in red bold, centered under the arrow.
visual_elements.position: bottom of right diagram, ~66-82% width, ~88-93% height

visual_elements.description: Diagonal red double-headed arrow on the right side of the block running lower-left to upper-right parallel to the depth direction; labels 'Batch size' and '(5 samples)' in red bold rotated to run diagonally alongside the arrow.

imagery: No photographs or clip-art; all graphics are flat-shaded 3D cube illustrations in oblique/isometric vector style: a green 1x5 column (left), a green 4x5 grid (middle), and a five-layer magenta/yellow/orange/green/blue 4x5x5 block (right)
Small red cursor-like dash artifact at the very top-left of the video frame
Solid black video-player control bar overlapping the bottom-left edge of the slide
typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title is very large (~40pt) bold red, title case with parentheses. Label-box text is bold (~14-16pt) with inline multi-color emphasis: green for 'One'/'FIVE', blue for filter/channel counts ('one filter', '4 filters', '[4 Channels]'), red for everything else. Dimension labels are bold (~11-12pt) red and rotated to align with their arrows (vertical, horizontal, diagonal). Slide number is bold red inside a yellow circle. No italics, no bullet lists, no serif fonts anywhere.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built: all three diagrams, all label boxes and all three dimension arrows are visible simultaneously; no mid-build/partial-reveal state detected.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with white (#FFFFFF) background. 2. Draw a red (#CC0000) rectangle outline (~2.5pt, no fill) inset ~2% around the whole slide as the outer frame. 3. Add a centered text box near the top (~y 8-20%) with 'Batch Data (Feature Vectors)' in Arial Bold ~40pt, color #CC0000. 4. Add a small oval (~x 90%, y 10%) filled #FFFF00 with a 1.5pt #CC0000 outline containing '42' in red bold ~14pt, centered. 5. Draw a thin blue (#0000CC) rectangle outline (~2pt, no fill) from ~x 7% to ~x 93% and ~y 24% to ~y 95% to enclose the content area. 6. Left label box: white-filled rectangle with thin red border at ~x 8-30%, y 35-43%; two lines, Arial Bold ~14pt, centered: line 1 'Feature Vector of ' (red) + 'One' (#66CC00) + ' Input' (red); line 2 'Sample (Using ' (red) + 'one filter' (#0000CC) + ')' (red). 7. Left diagram: build one 3D cube as a grouped shape - bright-green (#7CFC00) front square, mid-green (#66CC00) top parallelogram, dark-green (#4C9A00) right-side parallelogram, thin white gaps; duplicate and stack 5 vertically at ~x 16-23%, y 46-80%. 8. Middle label box: same style at ~x 34-62%, y 35-43%; line 1 'Feature Vectors of ' (red) + 'One' (#66CC00) + ' Input Sample' (red); line 2 '(Using ' (red) + '4 filters' (#0000CC) + ')  ' (red) + '[4 Channels]' (#0000CC). 9. Middle diagram: tile the cube into a 4-column x 5-row grid (20 cubes) at ~x 39-54%, y 44-78%. 10. Right label box: same style at ~x 65-92%, y 29-42%; three lines: 'Feature Vectors of :' (red); 'FIVE' (#66CC00 bold) + '  Input Samples  ' (red) + '[mini-Batch]' (bold red); 'Using ' (red) + '4 filters' (#0000CC) + ' ' (red) + '[4 Channels]' (#0000CC). 11. Right diagram: draw five 4x5 cube-grid layers using the same cube construction, colored front-to-back magenta #CC00CC, yellow #FFD700, orange #FF7F00, green #00A800, blue #4477AA; offset each successive layer up and to the right; send rear layers behind so the front magenta layer overlaps them, leaving rear top faces and the blue layer's right-side faces visible; place at ~x 63-90%, y 42-93%. 12. Add a small white/gray arrow between the magenta and yellow layers near the top pointing down-right. 13. Add three red (#CC0000) double-headed arrows with bold red labels: vertical arrow left of the magenta layer with 'Feature Vector' rotated 90 degrees; horizontal arrow below the magenta layer with 'Channels' / '(4 Filters)' beneath it; diagonal arrow on the right side with 'Batch size' / '(5 samples)' rotated diagonally. 14. Omit the black bottom-left bar and the top-left red dash - they are video-player artifacts, not slide content.
